display.purpose: The single marketing headline (login); extra-bold, 110% width.

page-title.purpose: The one heading of an app screen (category name or "Todas as tarefas", "Painel", "Perfil"); 110% width.

wordmark.purpose: "RoutinXP" set in text, kept as a fallback only. The UI shows the horizontal logo (public/marca/routinxp-logo-horizontal.svg): 2.75rem tall on the login, 2rem in the side menu, 1.875rem in the mobile top bar.

headline.purpose: Titles inside panels, dialogs, empty states and single-task pages.

stat-figure.purpose: Painel streak figures ("6 dias"), above their Label caption; tabular.

body-lead.purpose: One supporting paragraph under a display headline, muted, max 46ch.

body.purpose: Default text; tabular figures on at the root.

row-title.purpose: Task and timeline titles (clamped to two lines) and side-menu items.

meta.purpose: Category line, due dates, counts, hints, timeline times; 0.75rem for chart axis/cap labels and secondary figures.

segment.purpose: Segmented filter labels, sentence case with a count or a period ("7 dias").

label.purpose: Uppercase field labels, toggles, Lista group headings, Kanban column titles, Painel card titles and timeline day headings.

badge.purpose: NÍVEL pill; 0.8125rem inside the login level meter.

xp-figure.purpose: XP counter, +n XP labels, the top-bar streak figure and the Painel total; tabular, counts up.

focus-clock.purpose: Time left on the Foco clock only; the largest type in the app, 110% width, tabular, sized by container (cqi). Ink running, Muted paused.

shadows.name: panel-lift
shadows.purpose: Token --shadow. Every panel, dialog, account menu, toast, chart tooltip and the open mobile drawer; the single elevation. The docked side menu has none.

shadows.name: fab-glow
shadows.purpose: Floating action button over content (60rem and below).

shadows.name: focus-halo
shadows.purpose: Focused input, with a Soft Violet border.

shadows.name: selected-inset
shadows.purpose: The side menu current page; neutral outline, not a lift.

shadows.name: swatch-ring
shadows.purpose: Checked color swatch in the category dialog.

shadows.name: level-up-pulse
shadows.purpose: Transient, at the peak of the badge pulse on level change.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Token --ease-out. The single easing for every state transition and fill.

motion.name: xp-fill
motion.purpose: XP bar fill via translateX; matches the 700ms count-up (quartic ease-out).

motion.name: xp-flight
motion.purpose: Login demo: +n XP flying from the row's XP label to the demo counter; scale 1.1 to 0.75, fades in the last 20%.

motion.name: xp-flight-app
motion.purpose: App: fixed-position +n XP (1rem, 800, green) from the completed row's check or the Kanban drop point to the top bar's XP figure; scale 1.15 to 0.75, fades in the last 20%. Stats apply on arrival; 850ms fallback timer. No flight for 0 XP.

motion.name: level-hold
motion.purpose: Bar holds full in the old level before snapping (no transition) to the new level; badge pulses. No animation on first load or stats resync.

motion.name: level-toast-delay
motion.purpose: After the flight lands, the level toast waits for the fill-and-hold to play out before appearing.

motion.name: badge-pulse
motion.purpose: NÍVEL badge on level change.

motion.name: check-pop
motion.purpose: App task check on completion (login demo: 0.4s, 1.18).

motion.name: row-completed-wash
motion.purpose: Just-completed row flashes green and settles.

motion.name: tab-bar
motion.purpose: Active tab underline.

motion.name: notice-in
motion.purpose: Error notice and level-up banner entrance.

motion.name: dialog-in
motion.purpose: Modal dialog entrance.

motion.name: toast-in
motion.purpose: Toast entrance.

motion.name: toast-timer
motion.purpose: Undo toast time bar. Error and info toasts dismiss at 6s, the level toast at 5s.

motion.name: menu-collapse
motion.purpose: Side menu between 16.25rem and the 4.25rem icon rail (desktop); choice persisted in localStorage.

motion.name: drawer
motion.value: transform 0.3s ease-out, translateX(-100%) to 0; visibility hidden after close
motion.purpose: Mobile side-menu drawer; closed it leaves the tab order.

motion.name: reveal
motion.purpose: Row Excluir overlay and chart tooltip on hover/focus.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Hover color, border and background changes.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: prefers-reduced-motion collapses all animation and transition; count-up jumps to the target.

motion.name: foco-morph
motion.purpose: Foco phase change (montar to rodar and back): the Intervalos panel becomes the clock; tasks and music slide to their new slots. Instant under reduced motion or without View Transitions.

motion.name: foco-paused
motion.value: color 0.3s ease-out; cycle pills background-color 0.3s ease-out
motion.purpose: Clock time and phase line dim to Muted on pause; cycle pills change state.

motion.name: checkbox
motion.purpose: Neutral checkbox fill on check.

breakpoints.name: single-column
breakpoints.purpose: At or below: login becomes one 30rem column; the side menu becomes an off-canvas drawer; the top bar shows menu button + logo and wraps the level pill to a second row; FAB replaces + Nova tarefa on every page; page title 1.375rem; dialog fields stack; the install invite strip shows only here.

breakpoints.name: painel-single
breakpoints.purpose: Painel grid collapses to one column by content width (side menu open, collapsed or drawer), not window width.

breakpoints.name: narrow
breakpoints.purpose: At or below: Kanban columns scroll-snap horizontally at 86%; in Lista, Dia and Linha do tempo the deadline badge and XP move to the meta line under the title, as in Kanban.

breakpoints.name: compact
breakpoints.purpose: At or below: Painel category bars stack name/count over a full-width bar; timeline time joins the category line.

breakpoints.name: touch
breakpoints.purpose: Row Excluir overlay hidden; deletion lives in the edit dialog.

breakpoints.name: foco-single
breakpoints.purpose: Foco grid becomes one column by content width, ordered stage (Intervalos or clock), Iniciar or Agora, tasks, music.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one solid action per form; full width in a login footer, right-aligned in dialogs. Compact 40px variant only in the top bar.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn"><svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M8 3v10M3 8h10" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>Nova tarefa</button> <button class="ds-btn ds-btn--compacto">Nova tarefa</button>

components.name: Link Button
components.description: Secondary routes and dismissals: forgot password, cancel, undo.
components.css: .ds-link { padding: 0.25rem 0; border: 0; background: none; font-family: 'Archivo Variable', 'Archivo', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--purple-soft, #c4b5fd); text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: var(--purple-link-line, rgb(196 181 253 / 0.4)); text-decoration-thickness: 1px; text-underline-offset: 4px; cursor: pointer; transition: text-decoration-color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-link:hover { text-decoration-color: var(--purple-soft, #c4b5fd); } .ds-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--purple-soft, #c4b5fd); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Field
components.description: Uppercase label with optional violet toggle, Ground well input, violet focus halo.
components.html: Pelo menos 6 caracteres.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 0.5rem; font-family: 'Archivo Variable', 'Archivo', system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--ink, #f3f4f7); } .ds-field-top { display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; gap: 0.5rem; } .ds-label, .ds-toggle { font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.07em; text-transform: uppercase; line-height: 1.2; } .ds-label { color: var(--muted, #a3a7b3); } .ds-toggle { padding: 0; border: 0; background: none; color: var(--purple-soft, #c4b5fd); cursor: pointer; font-family: inherit; } .ds-input { width: 100%; min-height: 3rem; padding: 0 0.95rem; border: 1px solid var(--rule, #2e3039); border-radius: 10px; background: var(--ground, #121318); color: var(--ink, #f3f4f7); font: inherit; font-size: 1rem; transition: border-color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), box-shadow 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-input:hover { border-color: var(--rule-strong, #454856); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--purple-soft, #c4b5fd); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--purple-halo, rgb(124 58 237 / 0.35)); } .ds-hint { font-size: 0.8125rem; color: var(--muted, #a3a7b3); }

components.name: Underline Tabs
components.description: View/mode switch (Entrar / Criar conta, Lista / Kanban / Calendário) with a rounded violet bar that scales in under the active tab.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; gap: 1.75rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule, #2e3039); font-family: 'Archivo Variable', 'Archivo', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-tabs button { position: relative; padding: 0.25rem 0 0.9rem; border: 0; background: none; font: inherit; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted, #a3a7b3); cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-tabs button:hover, .ds-tabs button[aria-pressed='true'] { color: var(--ink, #f3f4f7); } .ds-tabs button::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: -1px; height: 3px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--purple, #7c3aed); transform: scaleX(0); transition: transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-tabs button[aria-pressed='true']::after { transform: scaleX(1); } .ds-tabs button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--purple-soft, #c4b5fd); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Segmented Filter
components.description: Filters rows within a view (Pendentes / Concluídas); Ground well, neutral active segment, no violet.
components.css: .ds-seg { display: inline-flex; padding: 3px; background: var(--ground, #121318); border: 1px solid var(--rule, #2e3039); border-radius: 999px; font-family: 'Archivo Variable', 'Archivo', system-ui, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-seg button { min-height: 2rem; padding: 0 0.85rem; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: none; font: inherit; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--muted, #a3a7b3); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-seg button:hover { color: var(--ink, #f3f4f7); } .ds-seg button[aria-pressed='true'] { background: var(--panel-2, #25262f); color: var(--ink, #f3f4f7); } .ds-seg button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--purple-soft, #c4b5fd); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Panel
components.description: The only container: one lift, 1px rule, sections divided by rules inside. Also the empty-state shell.
components.html:
Nenhuma tarefa ainda

Crie a primeira tarefa e ganhe XP ao concluir.
components.css: .ds-panel { padding: 2rem; background: var(--panel, #1c1d24); border: 1px solid var(--rule, #2e3039); border-radius: 16px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.35), 0 16px 40px -12px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.55); color: var(--ink, #f3f4f7); font-family: 'Archivo Variable', 'Archivo', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-panel-title { margin: 0 0 0.5rem; font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 800; line-height: 1.15; letter-spacing: -0.015em; } .ds-panel-text { margin: 0; max-width: 44ch; color: var(--muted, #a3a7b3); line-height: 1.55; }

components.name: Error Notice
components.description: Neutral error block with an inverted ERRO pill; no red.
components.css: .ds-notice { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 0.65rem; margin: 0; padding: 0.8rem 0.9rem; border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong, #454856); border-radius: 10px; background: var(--panel-2, #25262f); color: var(--ink, #f3f4f7); font-family: 'Archivo Variable', 'Archivo', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.45; } .ds-notice-tag { flex: none; margin-top: 0.1rem; padding: 0.2rem 0.45rem; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--ink, #f3f4f7); color: var(--ground, #121318); font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; line-height: 1.2; }

components.name: Side Menu
components.description: Full-height primary navigation in the Top Bar tier: logo + collapse button, Tarefas / Foco / Painel / Categorias e tags / Integrações / Perfil items with a neutral current page (Panel Two + Rule Strong inset, never violet), an "Instalar app" item (same recipe) above the user card when installable, user card linking to Perfil at the bottom. Collapses to a 4.25rem icon rail; a drawer below 60rem.

} .ds-xp-left { color: var(--muted, #a3a7b3); } .ds-xp-track { height: 0.5rem; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--panel-2, #25262f); overflow: hidden; } .ds-xp-fill { width: 100%; height: 100%; border-radius: inherit; components.name: Streak Reminder
components.description: Quiet Panel strip under the top bar when the streak is at risk: Muted clock, one plain sentence, "Ver tarefas" link off Tarefas, dismiss until tomorrow. No tag, no alarm color; distinct from the error notice. The same strip form carries the offline notice (Muted no-connection icon, no dismiss) and, on mobile, the install invite (download icon, "Instalar" link, dismiss forever); one strip at a time.
components.html:
Você ainda não concluiu nenhuma tarefa hoje. Conclua uma para manter sua sequência de 6 dias.

Ver tarefas
components.css: .ds-lembrete { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem; padding: 0.7rem 0.75rem 0.7rem 1rem; background: var(--panel, #1c1d24); border: 1px solid var(--rule, #2e3039); border-radius: 10px; color: var(--ink, #f3f4f7); font-family: 'Archivo Variable', 'Archivo', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; } .ds-lembrete > svg { flex: none; width: 1.125rem; height: 1.125rem; color: var(--muted, #a3a7b3); } .ds-lembrete p { flex: 1; margin: 0; } .ds-lembrete-link { padding: 0.25rem 0; font-weight: 600; color: var(--purple-soft, #c4b5fd); text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: var(--purple-link-line, rgb(196 181 253 / 0.4)); text-underline-offset: 4px; white-space: nowrap; transition: text-decoration-color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-lembrete-link:hover { text-decoration-color: var(--purple-soft, #c4b5fd); } .ds-lembrete-x { display: grid; place-items: center; flex: none; width: 2.25rem; height: 2.25rem; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: none; color: var(--muted, #a3a7b3); cursor: pointer; } .ds-lembrete-x:hover { background: var(--panel-2, #25262f); color: var(--ink, #f3f4f7); } .ds-lembrete-x svg { width: 0.875rem; height: 0.875rem; } .ds-lembrete a:focus-visible, .ds-lembrete button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--purple-soft, #c4b5fd); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Task Row
components.description: Three columns: check target, title + category line, relative due date (pending) or the XP label (completed: "…" muted while the server computes, "+0 XP" muted, earned "+n XP" full green). Excluir overlay on hover/focus.
components.html:
• hoje
  • +10 XP
  • +0 XP
components.css: .ds-list { margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; font-family: 'Archivo Variable', 'Archivo', system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--ink, #f3f4f7); } .ds-row + .ds-row { border-top: 1px solid var(--rule, #2e3039); narrative.overview:
RoutinXP follows the gamified learning-platform convention (DIO as the reference, Duolingo and Habitica as the craft bar) rather than an invented world. The system exists to make one moment land: a task is finished, "+n XP" flies to the counter, the number counts up, the bar fills, and on a level change the badge pulses. Everything else is quiet dark chrome that lets that moment be the brightest thing on screen.

Surfaces are a near-black ground with slightly lifted panels, separated by 1px rules. Density is operational, not editorial: rows, fields and meters sit close, labels are small uppercase, and figures are tabular so numbers never jitter while counting. Type is one family, Archivo, pushed to extra-bold and slightly expanded for the headline, page title, wordmark and badges; everything else is plain weight at normal width. Inside the app the level meter lives in the top bar on every screen, which is where the North Star gets its name.

Two accents carry all meaning, and both are taken from the RoutinXP logo (Action Violet and Level Green are the logo's own violet and green). Green is progress (XP, level, fills, completed checks, the completion drop target, the Painel's data). Purple is action (primary buttons, the FAB, the active tab bar, focus, link text). Selection is neutral. Every color is a custom property on `:root` so a later theme can swap the whole set by overriding variables on a `[data-tema]` scope; the system must stay expressible that way.
keyCharacteristics: Dark ground, lifted panels, 1px rules; no nested cards. App chrome (side menu and top bar) sits one step darker than the ground.
Exactly two accents with fixed jobs: green = XP, level and completion; purple = actions. Selection is neutral.
Archivo variable, extra-bold and 110-112.5% width for display, page title, wordmark and badges.
Tabular figures everywhere; XP numbers animate by counting, never by swapping.
Category color is data, shown as an 8px dot beside the category name (the color picker swatch is the only fill).
Charts are single-hue green magnitude, directly labeled once, with a table for screen readers.
Motion is one ease-out curve; reduced-motion collapses it to near zero.

rules.name: The Two Jobs Rule
rules.body: Green means progress and purple means action; neither ever stands in for the other. No green buttons, no purple XP, no third accent. Purple never marks selection: a current side-menu page, a selected chip, segment or swatch is shown with neutrals (Panel Two, Rule Strong, Ink). The single violet indicator is the active underline-tab bar, which marks the current mode. Green is also never spent on something that earned nothing: a "+0 XP" is Muted, and no flight launches for it.

rules.name: The Neutral Error Rule
rules.body: Errors are not red. An error is a notice on `panel-2` with a small pill tag in inverted neutrals (ink fill, ground text) reading "ERRO", followed by a plain-language sentence. This keeps the palette to two accents and keeps failure unalarming. The same holds for due dates: today and overdue get Ink and weight, never red. It holds for reduced rewards: when a completion earns less than usual (task created under 5 minutes ago, the daily XP cap reached or partly reached), an info toast names the reason in a plain sentence, in neutrals, with no tag and no red. And it holds for a streak at risk: the reminder is a Panel strip with a Muted clock, never an alarm. Losing the connection is the same: the offline strip is a Panel strip with a Muted no-connection icon and a plain sentence, no tag, no red.

rules.name: The Dot-Only Category Rule
rules.body: User-chosen category colors are data. They appear as an 8px round dot beside the category name (filter chips, the Categorias e tags list, row category line, Lista group headings, the Painel's category bars and timeline items), never as fills, borders, text color, bars or backgrounds, and never without the name. The one exception is the color picker, where the swatch itself is the choice and fills a 36px circle.

rules.name: The Swappable Theme Rule
rules.body: Components read colors only through the `:root` custom properties, effects included (glows, washes, halos, backdrop). A new theme is a new set of variable values, not new component CSS. The only color literals outside `:root` are the category swatch values, which are user data.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums` is set at the root and stays on; counting XP must never shift its neighbors.

rules.name: The Width-for-Rank Rule
rules.body: Only display, page title, wordmark and badges use the expanded width axis. Body, rows, side menu, charts, dialogs and forms stay at normal width. The Focus Clock is the one addition: the time on the Foco page reads as a scoreboard figure.

rules.name: The One Lift Rule
rules.body: A panel has exactly one elevation. Content inside a panel is never another shadowed card; it is divided by rules. The level pill inside the top bar is a bordered Panel fill with no shadow, and the shell strips (streak reminder, offline strip, install invite) are bordered Panel strips with no shadow. The chart tooltip is the one floating element inside a card; it lifts because it hovers over the data, not because it is a card.

rules.name: The Earned Record Rule
rules.body: In the app's Concluídas and the Painel timeline, an earned "+n XP" stays full-strength Level Green: it is the record of what the task earned. A "+0 XP" is Muted because it records that nothing was earned, not because anything was collected. The login demo dims its completed "+n XP" to 40% only because there the XP has visibly flown to the counter, and the dimmed label reads as "already collected". Do not carry the dimming into real lists.

rules.name: The Neutral Clock Rule
rules.body: Foco marks time and phase in neutrals only. The phase line, the time and the cycle pills are Ink, Muted and Rule Strong. They are never green, because time passing earns nothing, and never violet, because violet is for the actions (Iniciar foco, Retomar, Pausar, Adicionar). On this page green arrives only through task completion: the check, the green wash and the XP flight.

dos: Do read every color, including glows, washes, halos and the backdrop, through the `:root` custom properties so a theme can replace them in one place.
Do keep green for XP, level and completion, and purple for actions and focus; use Soft Violet when violet must be read as text.
Do mark selection and the current page with neutrals: Panel Two fill plus a Rule Strong outline or border.
Do put Deep Moss text on green fills and white text on violet fills.
Do separate content inside a panel with 1px Rules; list items are rows, not cards.
Do show category color as an 8px dot next to the category name; only the color picker fills a shape with it.
Do use underline tabs to switch views and the segmented pill to filter rows or ranges within a view.
Do show due dates relatively ("hoje", "amanhã", "12 set"), with today and overdue in Ink and weight.
Do keep an earned "+n XP" full-strength green in real lists and the timeline; it is the earned record. Show "+0 XP" and the pending "…" in Muted.
Do name the reason in a neutral info toast when a completion earns less than usual.
Do apply XP only when the flight lands, with a fallback timer so a stalled animation never withholds it.
Do draw charts in single-hue green with 4px rounded data ends, a neutral scale reference, one direct label on the extreme value, a hover tooltip, and a visually hidden table with the same data.
Do size responsive grids that sit beside the side menu by container query, not by window width.
Do use the horizontal logo as the wordmark (2.75rem login, 2rem side menu, 1.875rem mobile top bar) and the icon as favicon and collapsed-menu mark.
Do report errors with the neutral notice and its ERRO pill tag; keep the streak reminder, the offline strip and the install invite as tagless Panel strips, one at a time.
Do animate XP by count-up plus a `translateX` fill on the shared ease-out `cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)`, and let reduced-motion collapse it.
Do keep primary buttons and inputs at least 48px tall, completion targets and navigation items at least 44px, and icon buttons 40px.
Do draw new icons on the 16px grid with a 2px round-capped stroke in `currentColor`.
Do mark the focus phase, the time and the cycles in neutrals (Ink, Muted, Rule Strong), and leave green on the Foco page to task completion.
donts: Don't add a third accent, or use red for errors, overdue dates, deletion or a streak at risk.
Don't use purple, a colored side stripe, or the category color to mark a selected item or the current page.
Don't fill, border or tint surfaces or chart bars with category colors.
Don't nest a shadowed card inside a panel.
Don't use hard or offset shadows; the only shadows are the soft lift, the violet glows, the focus halo, the selected inset, the swatch ring and the transient level-up pulse.
Don't add mascots, confetti, or streak-loss warnings in alarm colors; the reward is the XP flight, the fill and the badge pulse.
Don't fly or color green an XP gain of zero, or show a reduced reward in red.
Don't label every bar, add gridlines, or use more than one hue for magnitude.
Don't set body, rows or forms in the expanded width; that axis is for display, page title, wordmark and badges.
Don't hardcode hex or rgb literals in component CSS; add a token instead.
Don't show placeholder numbers while stats load; use the neutral skeleton.
Don't frame, recolor or borrow colors from the Spotify embed; it brings its own surface, and the system's palette stays ours.
